story-context.title: Cumulative Points & Milestones
story-context.design-philosophy:
"How did they ever do their job without this?"
Students need visible progress markers. Without cumulative tracking, points feel like isolated daily events. Milestones create motivation (close to next badge), celebration (crossed 500!), and staff visibility into trajectories.
story-context.summary: Add cumulative point display and milestone badges to CurrentPlacementCard. Badges appear on title row. Progress bar toggles between days/points on click. Milestones auto-award when threshold crossed OR can be manually awarded. New Badges settings page for CRUD. Add 'bonus' type to behavior categories.

key-concepts.concept: MILESTONES = Achievement badges (auto when threshold met OR manual award) BONUS POINTS = Extra points added manually (never automatic) Flow: Bonus points → increases total → may trigger milestone auto-award
points_possible = days_served × periods_per_day × 10 Example: 20 days × 7 periods × 10 = 1,400 points possible
